title: ERRY resells Bonita alongside Flowable, so its BPM allegiance is split between competing engines
content:
ERRY appears in the Flowable Partner Finder while also reselling Bonita, which the research names as a competing BPM engine. The flag labels the situation divided loyalty and records a second, independent disqualifier: a Shanghai base outside the EU scope.

A reseller carrying two rival engines optimises for whatever a client has already chosen. That makes its listing a statement about breadth of catalogue rather than depth of practice, and it means references, staff specialisation and internal incentives cannot be assumed to favour either engine.

Divided loyalty shows up in three distinct forms across this sweep: reselling a rival engine here, primary allegiance to another platform vendor at BehaimITS, and dual Camunda tiers at EPAM and TCS. In each case the firm is also excluded on geography or scale, so no in-scope EU lead is being disqualified on allegiance alone — the criterion has so far only ever confirmed exclusions reached another way.
